steps.caption: Tasks sit under Today. Open the Tasks tab.
Filters: Open, Overdue, Snoozed, Stale and Done. Overdue ones are marked in red.
Search titles, choose Mine or Everyone, and filter by where the task came from.
Each task shows its status, due date, priority and source — 'Blocked' means it waits on another task.
Stale holds tasks overdue for too long, so they don't silently disappear.
To add your own, scroll to New task at the bottom.
Pick a due date — here, tomorrow.
Set the priority to High, then press Add.
The new task is in the list with its due date and priority.
When it's done, write what you did — that note is kept as evidence.
Press Complete. (Not today? Snooze it for 1, 3, 7 or 14 days instead.)
Done tasks move to the Done filter, with your note.
Your note is kept as evidence; Reopen brings a task back if needed.
